backend/main.mo: Main actor for the Smileup backend, defining data types and state for posts, comments, user profiles, notifications, messages, follows, friend requests, and visit history, along with all public API methods for social features.
backend/migration.mo: Data migration module that upgrades the actor state from an old schema to a new one by adding an empty `visitHistory` map while preserving all existing fields.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping three implemented features (StoriesRow profile bubbles with glow, click-to-navigate glowing bubbles, and auto-recording profile visits) to their relevant source files and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: A JSON document containing one-sentence summaries of each frontend source file, describing the purpose and notable changes of each component, page, hook, and stylesheet.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS entry file defining light and dark OKLCH CSS custom properties for the design token system (colors, borders, sidebar, charts).
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML shell that sets the page title to "Smileup" and mounts the React app via the `/src/main.tsx` module script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that wraps the app in ThemeProvider, QueryClientProvider, and InternetIdentityProvider, showing a loading spinner, the LandingPage for unauthenticated users, or the TanStack Router for authenticated users.
frontend/src/components/AvatarPlaceholde: Reusable avatar component that renders a user's profile picture if available, or falls back to gradient-colored initials, supporting multiple size variants and both legacy and new prop naming conventions.
frontend/src/components/BottomNav.tsx: Fixed bottom navigation bar with five icon-labeled tabs (Home, Explore, ShortSport, Create, Profile) that highlights the active route and hides itself on the ShortSport page.
frontend/src/components/CommentsSheet.ts: A bottom sheet component for displaying and submitting comments on a post, supporting both open/onOpenChange and isOpen/onClose prop conventions.
frontend/src/components/editor/AudioPane: An editor panel for managing audio tracks, supporting file upload and mock recording, with per-track volume sliders, mute toggles, and removal controls.
frontend/src/components/editor/DesignPan: A React panel component for editing canvas design settings including aspect ratio, background color/gradient presets, shape overlays, and decorative elements. Exposes controls that update the shared EditorState via an onUpdate callback.
frontend/src/components/editor/EditorCan: A canvas-based preview component that renders the current editor state including background color, text layers, sticker layers, filter CSS, vignette gradient, glitch, and letterbox effects using the HTML5 Canvas API.
frontend/src/components/editor/EditorTim: A timeline UI component that displays video/image/blank clips on a scrollable ruler with a draggable playhead, supports scrubbing, clip removal, and adding new blank clips.
frontend/src/components/editor/EffectsPa: A panel for toggling visual motion-graphic effects (confetti, glitch, letterbox, etc.) on the editor state, displaying active effects as removable tags.
frontend/src/components/editor/ExportPan: A panel for exporting and sharing the edited video, providing title/description metadata fields, a video preview, and a download button that creates a blob URL from the source file.
frontend/src/components/editor/FiltersPa: A panel offering one-click filter presets (Moody, Cinematic, Noir, etc.) and individual sliders for brightness, contrast, saturation, hue, vignette, and other filter settings stored in EditorState.
frontend/src/components/editor/StickersP: A panel component for adding and managing emoji sticker layers on video clips, supporting categorized emoji selection, placement, size/rotation controls, and timing per sticker.
frontend/src/components/editor/TextPanel: A panel component for adding and editing text overlay layers on video, with controls for font, color, size, alignment, bold/italic, animation, and timing.
frontend/src/components/editor/Transitio: A panel component that displays a library of video transitions and allows users to apply specific transitions between consecutive clips in the editor.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Root layout component that wraps all pages with a TopBar, BottomNav, and a main content area rendered via TanStack Router's Outlet.
frontend/src/components/NotificationsPan: A dropdown panel that lists user notifications (follows, messages) with avatars, relative timestamps, and click-to-navigate behavior, marking items as read on interaction.
frontend/src/components/PostCard.tsx: A card component for displaying a single post with media (image or video), like/comment/share/bookmark actions, view tracking, and navigation to the author's profile.
A dialog modal that shows a grid of the current user's posts as thumbnails, allowing selection of one to share in a message.
frontend/src/components/ShareModal.tsx: A dialog modal for sharing a post with selected friends via direct messages, fetching the friend list and sending messages to all selected recipients.
frontend/src/components/StoriesRow.tsx: A horizontally scrollable row of user avatar bubbles (stories) that highlights profiles with new posts and navigates to their latest post or profile on click, plus a 'Your Story' button.
frontend/src/components/StoryViewerModal: A full-screen modal component for viewing a single story, displaying the user's avatar, name, handle, and a progress bar, with Escape key and backdrop-click dismissal.
frontend/src/components/TopBar.tsx: A fixed top navigation bar with the app wordmark, search navigation, a notification bell with unread badge and dropdown list, and a logout button.
frontend/src/components/TrendingProfiles: A horizontally scrollable section displaying top creator cards with rank, avatar, and stats, fetched via useGetTopCreators, with loading skeletons and an empty state.
frontend/src/components/VideoCard.tsx: A card component for displaying a video post with thumbnail, play button, duration, like/bookmark/share actions, and a follow button for the post author.
frontend/src/components/YourStoryPopup.t: A small dropdown popup anchored below a trigger element offering two actions: viewing the user's own posts or creating a new post, with outside-click dismissal.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A React hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor using React Query, invalidating dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and provider, managing AuthClient creation, login/logout flow, and identity persistence across page reloads.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Centralizes all React Query hooks for backend data fetching and mutations, covering user profiles, posts, comments, notifications, messages, and social features.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Inter and Syne fonts, sets up Tailwind base/components/utilities, defines CSS custom properties for dark and light themes using oklch colors, and declares utility classes and keyframe animations.
frontend/src/lib/mockData.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces (Post, Comment, User, Story, Message, Conversation) and exports mock data arrays (MOCK_USERS, MOCK_STORIES, etc.) used for UI development and testing.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Exports utility functions: cn for merging Tailwind class names, formatNumber for K/M abbreviations, formatTime for mm:ss formatting, and timeAgo for relative timestamps.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with QueryClientProvider, InternetIdentityProvider, and renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/CreatePostPage.tsx: Page component for creating a new post, supporting file upload or URL input for photo/video/GIF/poster media types, with caption input and submission via the useCreatePost mutation hook.
frontend/src/pages/EditorPage.tsx: Full-featured video/design editor page that manages editor state (clips, text layers, stickers, audio, filters, effects) and renders a panel-based UI with tools for trimming, filters, effects, stickers, design, and export.
frontend/src/pages/ExplorePage.tsx: Explore page with a debounced search input and tabs for browsing/searching posts or users, fetching data via useGetAllPosts and useSearchUsers hooks and rendering results with navigation support.
frontend/src/pages/FeedPage.tsx: Main feed page that fetches and displays posts sorted by timestamp with skeleton loading states, a stories row, trending profiles section, and a load-more pagination control.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Landing page for the Smileup app featuring a gradient wordmark, tagline, Internet Identity login button with loading state, feature highlights, and a footer.
frontend/src/pages/MessagesPage.tsx: Full messaging page with a conversation list sidebar and message thread view, supporting text and shared post messages, friend request management, and unread counts.
frontend/src/pages/MessageThreadPage.tsx: Thin wrapper that extracts the `principalId` route param and renders `MessagesPage` with that principal pre-selected.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: Authenticated user's own profile page with editable display name, handle, bio, and profile picture, plus a grid of their posts and follower/following counts.
frontend/src/pages/ShortSportPage.tsx: TikTok-style vertical reel feed page that plays video posts full-screen with like, comment, share, and auto-scroll functionality.
frontend/src/pages/UserProfilePage.tsx: Public profile page for any user identified by principal or handle, showing their posts, follower stats, follow button, and friend request actions.
frontend/src/routeTree.ts: Defines and exports the TanStack Router route tree, mapping all app paths (feed, explore, editor, profile, shortsport, create, user profile, messages) to their page components.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, persisting, and cleaning URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, using sessionStorage for cross-navigation persistence.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom CSS-variable-based colors, Inter/Syne fonts, radius tokens, glow box shadows, and fade/scale/pulse animations.
project_state.json: Project state manifest describing a social app on the Internet Computer with Motoko backend, Internet Identity auth, profile row logic, glow effects, and visit history; tracks existing features and pending architectural requests.
